content.text: LippoKarawang.com is a digital gateway that introduces Lippo Karawang City as an integrated destination for living, business, healthcare, education, and lifestyle. The website helps users explore multiple districts through a clear and structured experience.
The main goal was to simplify a complex ecosystem into an intuitive journey while strengthening the positioning of Lippo Karawang as a modern integrated city for residents, visitors, and investors.

To reduce complexity, the homepage introduced a destination-based navigation concept, allowing users to enter the platform based on their specific needs such as residential, industrial, commercial, healthcare, and lifestyle areas.

Each destination page was structured with a clear hierarchy: overview, key value, facilities, and masterplan. This approach helps users quickly understand the area and builds a strong investment and exploration narrative.
Color coding was used to differentiate districts and improve recognition across the platform, while clean layouts ensured high readability for data-heavy content.
The masterplan became a core visual element to show the scale, zoning, and connectivity of the city, increasing clarity and user trust.
This project demonstrates how strong information architecture and navigation strategy can transform a complex corporate ecosystem into a simple and engaging digital experience.
